Bread at six, cakes by order

We've baked pan de sal on Osmeña Boulevard since 1987. The first tray comes out at 6:00, and it's usually gone by 8.

Order a cake

What we bake

Pan de sal, ensaymada with queso de bola, ube rolls on weekends, and cakes for birthdays and weddings. Cakes need three days' notice; wedding cakes need two weeks.

Prices

Pan de sal is ₱5 each or ₱55 for a dozen. Ensaymada is ₱45. A one-kilo chocolate cake starts at ₱950.

Hours

Monday to Saturday, 5:30 to 19:00. Closed Sundays and on New Year's Day. Call Liza at 0917 555 0142 for cake orders, or message our Facebook page.
